column1: # ONE CONCELHO IN THE BEIRA ALTA — AND THE DNA THREAD THIS ARCHIVE FILED AS "NOT WORTH BELIEVING".
# Research on the parents and grandparents named in Ivone's birth assento, 27 September 2026.
# Sources: pt.wikipedia for the administrative geography; Digitarq (digitarq.arquivos.pt), the
# Portuguese national archives portal, 8 million records and 63 million images, free and public.

column2: value

column1: # ---------------- THE GEOGRAPHY, AND IT IS TIGHTER THAN A DISTRICT ----------------
what the assento gives
column2: her father JOAQUIM JÚLIO DE FIGUEIREDO of the freguesia of VIMIEIRO, and her mother LEONIA DOS SANTOS MATA of the freguesia of NEGOZELA.

column1: *** BOTH ARE FREGUESIAS OF SANTA COMBA DÃO, DISTRITO DE VISEU ***
column2: the município lists them as "Óvoa e Vimieiro" and "Treixedo e Nagozela" — pairs merged in the administrative reorganisation of 2012/13, which means each pair was two ADJACENT parishes before. Santa Comba Dão sits between the rivers Dão and Mondego, between Viseu and Coimbra. Vimieiro is three kilometres from the town.

column1: *** AND THE ARCHIVE'S PORTUGUESE DNA MATCH TRACES TO TREIXEDO ***
column2: the DNA page records, as a loose thread, that "the two Portuguese matches that were opened both trace to the Viseu district — TREIXEDO IN SANTA COMBA DÃO, and Tondela and Castro Daire", and judges it "Worth noting; not worth believing." TREIXEDO AND NAGOZELA ARE NOW A SINGLE FREGUESIA. Ivone's mother came from the parish that the DNA match's parish was merged with.

column1: what that does and does not do
column2: IT DOES NOT MAKE THE MATCH A RELATIVE. The archive's own cautions stand: both matches are distant, one has no documented link to Ivone at all, and the closest Portuguese match by a wide margin gives no place more specific than "Portugal". WHAT CHANGES IS THE SIZE OF THE COINCIDENCE. It was a district — Viseu has 24 municípios and half a million people. It is now one concelho of 11,000, and two adjacent parishes inside it, reached from a document that knows nothing about DNA.

column1: # ---------------- *** THE TRAP, AND IT IS THE LUTHERSTRASSE TRAP AGAIN *** ----------------
THERE ARE TWO VIMIEIROS
column2: one in SANTA COMBA DÃO (Viseu) and one in ARRAIOLOS (Évora). Searching Digitarq for "batismo Vimieiro" returns Évora parish registers — PT/ADEVR/PRQ/EVR12 — because the ÉVORA Vimieiro's registers are digitised and the Viseu one's are not. A NAME SEARCH WILL PULL THE WRONG PARISH FIRST, EVERY TIME.

column1: what settles it, and it is the mother
column2: NEGOZELA/NAGOZELA EXISTS IN SANTA COMBA DÃO AND NOT IN ÉVORA. The mother's parish is unambiguous, and a couple from one concelho emigrating together is ordinary. THE FATHER'S VIMIEIRO IS THEREFORE ALMOST CERTAINLY THE VISEU ONE — AND "ALMOST CERTAINLY" IS NOT "DOCUMENTED". His own record will say, and until it does this stays a reasoned preference and not a fact.

column1: # ---------------- WHAT IS AVAILABLE, AND IT IS NOT THE PARISH REGISTERS ----------------
*** THE PARISH REGISTERS OF SANTA COMBA DÃO ARE NOT ON DIGITARQ ***
column2: the Arquivo Distrital de Viseu's holdings there are JUD (judicial) and AC (civil government) only — searches on Nagozela, Treixedo and Vimieiro return no PT/ADVIS/PRQ series at all, while other districts' PRQ fonds come back readily. The grandparents' generation — ANTÓNIO JÚLIO DE FIGUEIREDO and ANA PEREIRA DE FIGUEIREDO, AUGUSTO MATA and JÚLIA DURÃES MATA — is therefore NOT reachable online from this archive's usual instruments. The registers exist; they are at Viseu, and on microfilm at FamilySearch, which requires an account this archive does not create.

column1: WHAT IS ONLINE AND DIGITISED: THE VISEU PASSPORT APPLICATIONS
column2: PT/ADVIS/AC/GCVIS/H-D/001/xxxxx — "Pedido de passaporte de [name]", the Governo Civil de Viseu's applications, CATALOGUED INDIVIDUALLY BY NAME with image counts against them, running through the 1900s and 1910s. THIS IS THE EMIGRATION ITSELF: the parents left Santa Comba Dão for Lourenço Marques before March 1922, and an application names the applicant, the parish, and usually the destination.

column1: and the Santa Comba Dão courts
column2: PT/ADVIS/JUD/TJCSCD — the Tribunal Judicial da Comarca de Santa Comba Dão, on Digitarq. Inventories after death (inventários por óbito) name heirs, which is how a Portuguese family is reconstructed when the registers are out of reach.

column1: # ---------------- *** AND TWO PEOPLE ARE ALREADY IN THE NATIONAL ARCHIVE, BY NAME *** ----------------
*** JOAQUIM JULIO DE FIGUEIREDO — PT/TT/DGAP-DIA/001/056204 ***
column2: Arquivo Nacional da Torre do Tombo. "Direção-Geral da Administração Pública, Departamento de Integração Administrativa, PROCESSOS DE FUNCIONÁRIOS DO ULTRAMAR", caixa 6377, processo 103541. DATES 1922 TO 1954. A PERSONNEL FILE FOR AN OVERSEAS CIVIL SERVANT, opening in the very year Ivone was born at Lourenço Marques.

column1: *** FREDERICO PINTO DA ROCHA — PT/TT/DGAP-DIA/001/059068, AND A SECOND FILE ***
column2: same series, caixa 6629, processo 106864, DATES 1940 TO 1983; and PT/TT/DGAP-DIA/002/7338, 1950 to 1984. HE MARRIED IVONE AT LOURENÇO MARQUES IN NOVEMBER 1939 and a colonial service file opens the following year.

column1: what such a file contains
column2: a career in the colonial administration: postings, dates, and the personal particulars the service required — birth date and place, parents, marital status and dependants. IT IS THE KIND OF FILE THAT ANSWERS FOUR QUESTIONS AT ONCE.

column1: *** AND IT WOULD EXPLAIN THE SHAPE OF HER LIFE ***
column2: a daughter born in the colony in 1922 to a man with an overseas service file from 1922, who at seventeen marries another overseas functionary. THIS IS A COLONIAL CIVIL SERVICE FAMILY, not settlers and not traders, and that is a different social world from the one this archive had been imagining for her.

column1: NOT CONFIRMED, AND THE NAMES ARE NOT RARE
column2: Joaquim Júlio de Figueiredo and Frederico Pinto da Rocha are both plausible Portuguese names and neither catalogue entry carries a parish, a birth date or a parent. THE DATES ARE THE WHOLE OF THE ARGUMENT — 1922 and 1940 — and dates are the commonest coincidence there is. These are CANDIDATES TO BE ORDERED AND READ, not identifications.

column1: 1 — the two Torre do Tombo files
column2: orderable from the ANTT in Lisbon. If the Figueiredo file names a wife LEONIA DOS SANTOS MATA or a daughter IVONE, the identification is made and the paternal line is open.

column1: 2 — the Viseu passport applications
column2: free, digitised, name-indexed on Digitarq, and searchable now. The emigration of the parents is the event that produced everyone in this archive's Portuguese half.

column1: 3 — the 1939 marriage entry at Lourenço Marques
column2: still the cheapest single document, because a Portuguese marriage assento names the parents of BOTH parties.

column1: 4 — the parish registers, by letter or in person
column2: Arquivo Distrital de Viseu, for Nagozela, Vimieiro and Treixedo. NOT ONLINE, and that is the finding rather than a failure to look.
